name: Hacks
description: Explore a dark mentorship that forms between Deborah Vance, a legendary Las Vegas comedian, and an entitled, outcast 25-year-old.

videos.title: There Is No Line
videos.overview: An entitled young writer and a waning comedy legend must put aside their differences to save their careers.

videos.title: Primm
videos.overview: Deborah tests Ava's limits.

videos.title: A Gig's a Gig
videos.overview: Ava gains insight into Deborah's past.

videos.title: D'Jewelry
videos.overview: At DJ's jewelry expo, Ava comes to better understand Deborah and DJ's complicated mother-daughter relationship. Deborah receives an unexpected piece of ammunition against Marty.

videos.title: Falling
videos.overview: Deborah blackmails Marty. Ava has a wild night to remember in Vegas that puts everything in perspective.

videos.title: New Eyes
videos.overview: While Deborah recovers from surgery, she and Ava have a unique bonding experience when Deborah dispels a major misperception about her past.

videos.title: Tunnel of Love
videos.overview: DJ's birthday party becomes a surprise dual function. Meanwhile, Deborah and Marty reconnect.

videos.title: 1.69 Million
videos.overview: With a little encouragement from Ava, Deborah’s unpolished set sparks a career-defining moment.

videos.title: Interview
videos.overview: Ava tries to keep a secret from Deborah, but someone in Deborah’s inner-circle leverages the truth. Meanwhile, Deborah stares down the barrel of her first radically honest show.

videos.title: I Think She Will
videos.overview: For her final performance at the Palmetto, Deborah must decide between playing it safe and putting her entire career on the line. Meanwhile, Ava deals with a family crisis.

videos.title: There Will Be Blood
videos.overview: Deborah eagerly anticipates trying out her new material on the road, while Ava dreads the fallout of an explosive email.

videos.title: Quid Pro Quo
videos.overview: Deborah embraces tour life. Ava grapples with the value of honesty. Jimmy learns the harsh realities of Hollywood dealmaking.

videos.title: Trust the Process
videos.overview: Deborah continues to workshop her material on the road, as Ava adapts to a new lifestyle. Marcus is overwhelmed by life without Wilson.

videos.title: The Captain's Wife
videos.overview: While Deb struggles to connect with her audience on a cruise, Ava finds herself an unexpected hit.

videos.title: Retired
videos.overview: An impromptu detour finds Deborah reckoning with long-held guilt while reconnecting with a former comedian friend.

videos.title: The Click
videos.overview: A girls’ night out finds Ava attempting to connect with her mother – and Deborah embracing some unexpected company.

videos.title: On the Market
videos.overview: Deborah and her team head to LA to pitch her new set as a comedy special.

videos.title: The One, the Only
videos.overview: Deborah prepares to take the stage for her taping as Ava deals with a new opportunity.

videos.title: Just for Laughs
videos.overview: As Deborah prepares to accept an award in Montreal, Ava does her best to avoid her former employer.

videos.title: Better Late
videos.overview: Deborah and Ava struggle to stay out of one another's orbits – especially when Deborah lands an unexpected opportunity.

videos.title: The Roast of Deborah Vance
videos.overview: After learning there's a Late Night vacancy, Deborah makes sure everything – and everyone – is operating at its finest for her roast.

videos.title: Join the Club
videos.overview: Deborah is invited to hang with some of her favorite comedians, Jimmy finally lands a general meeting with Winnie, and Marcus recruits Ava for trivia.

videos.title: One Day
videos.overview: As Deborah contends with writer’s block and Ava with a broken heart, the pair decide to clear their heads in the woods.

videos.title: Par for the Course
videos.overview: Deborah participates in a golf tournament to get face time with the cable affiliates who could decide her future.

videos.title: The Deborah Vance Christmas Spectacular
videos.overview: Deborah braces for Kathy's attendance at her Christmas party, while Jimmy and Kayla refuse to call it quits on the comedian's Late Night dreams.

videos.title: Yes, And
videos.overview: A calendar mix-up finds Deborah double booked ... just as an unfortunate supercut of her most problematic early jokes starts circulating.

videos.title: Bulletproof
videos.overview: As Deborah works to perfect her second run at Late Night, Ava receives a dream offer, and Jimmy and Kayla seek to grow their company.

videos.title: Big, Brave Girl
videos.overview: With Deborah determined to boot her from Late Night, Ava attempts to beat her boss at her own game.

videos.title: Cover Girls
videos.overview: As Deborah and Ava's feud threatens the future of their show, Jimmy and Kayla have their own struggles.

videos.title: What Happens in Vegas
videos.overview: As pressure mounts to craft a perfect first episode, Deborah and Ava continue to clash over creative control on their writers' "retreat" in Vegas.

videos.title: I Love LA
videos.overview: As the taping of her first Late Night episode approaches, Deborah experiences a shocking "first," while Ava makes a new romantic connection.

videos.title: Clickable Face
videos.overview: Following a focus group, Deborah goes above and beyond to reach a coveted demo, while Ava desperately tries to maintain the show's integrity.

videos.title: Mrs. Table
videos.overview: Deborah receives the "Courage in Comedy" award, while Ava reaches a breaking point.

videos.title: D'Christening
videos.overview: Deborah and Ava return to Vegas for DJ's son's christening. Jimmy and Kayla have their hands full with Dance Mom.

videos.title: Witch of the Week
videos.overview: Deborah pitches a new approach for the show. Nina arrives with a plan for Ava's future. Jimmy struggles to keep up, while Kayla fields an offer.

videos.title: A Slippery Slope
videos.overview: Deborah and Ava struggle as Late Night lands in unwanted controversy. While Jimmy navigates the worst day, Kayla thrives.

videos.title: Heaven
videos.overview: Deborah deals with a difficult contract negotiation.

videos.title: EGOT
videos.overview: After returning from Singapore to a career further smeared by Bob Lipka, Deborah decides to shift the narrative and focus on achieving EGOT status.

videos.title: Number One Fan
videos.overview: After she's turned down by Madison Square Garden, Deborah's attempt to reignite her fanbase doesn't go as planned. Meanwhile, Jimmy unexpectedly gets to pitch one of his idols, and Ava meets her first fan.

videos.title: No New Tricks
videos.overview: Deborah hits it off with the Palmetto's new artist in residence. Marcus sets out to save a historic casino, and Marty has uninvited wedding guests.

videos.title: Who's Making Dinner?
videos.overview: Ava finds inspiration at a 50th anniversary event for Who's Making Dinner?, while Deborah is reminded of painful memories.

videos.title: D'Amazing Race
videos.overview: When The Amazing Race announces a celebrity edition, DJ holds Deborah to her longstanding promise of partnering up. After Deborah gives her blessing, Ava attempts to secure the rights for her Who's Making Dinner? reboot.

videos.title: QuikScribbl
videos.overview: With construction on The Diva heading way over budget, Deborah meets with an AI investor, causing friction between her and Ava. Meanwhile, Jimmy and Kayla head out on a road trip after being tasked with landing the new casino's comic in residence.

videos.title: Montecito
videos.overview: After deciding on a very specific outfit for her MSG show, Deborah is forced to grovel for the esteemed suit...only to find herself on an unexpected couple's weekend in Montecito with Ava.

videos.title: The Cube
videos.overview: When she's asked to promote her on-sale ticket date, Deborah gets creative with a workaround...only to be stymied by another obstacle. Meanwhile, Kayla and Jimmy find themselves at odds after being served with a lawsuit.

videos.title: The Garden
videos.overview: While Ava pitches her reboot to the network, Deborah does final press ahead of her MSG show and fills a key staffing need at The Diva. Then, Deborah prepares to take the stage for the biggest show of her career – which looks much different than she imagined.

videos.title: Hacks
videos.overview: As Ava embarks on her next project, Deborah, Marcus, and Marty officially open The Diva, and Jimmy's new role proves fortuitous. Then, on the heels of accomplishing everything she's ever wanted, Deborah reveals her final chapter.

awards: Won 12 Primetime Emmys. 101 wins & 243 nominations total
